mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT ui.user_id, m.CONTENT, m.TYPE, m.CREATE_TIME, m.IS_RECALL, m.FROM_USER_ID, m.TO_USER_ID, COALESCE(um.unread_count, 0) AS unread_count, '1' AS chat_type FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN FROM_USER_ID = #{userId} THEN TO_USER_ID ELSE FROM_USER_ID END AS user_id, MAX(CREATE_TIME) AS last_message_time FROM im_message WHERE (FROM_USER_ID = #{userId} OR TO_USER_ID = #{userId}) AND DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' GROUP BY CASE WHEN FROM_USER_ID = #{userId} THEN TO_USER_ID ELSE FROM_USER_ID END) AS ui JOIN im_message m ON ((m.FROM_USER_ID = ui.user_id AND m.TO_USER_ID = #{userId}) OR (m.FROM_USER_ID = #{userId} AND m.TO_USER_ID = ui.user_id)) JOIN sys_user su ON ui.user_id = su.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN FROM_USER_ID = #{userId} THEN TO_USER_ID ELSE FROM_USER_ID END AS user_id, COUNT(*) AS unread_count FROM im_message WHERE (TO_USER_ID = #{userId}) AND DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' AND IS_READ = 2 GROUP BY CASE WHEN FROM_USER_ID = #{userId} THEN TO_USER_ID ELSE FROM_USER_ID END) AS um ON ui.user_id = um.user_id WHERE m.CREATE_TIME = ui.last_message_time AND m.CHAT_TYPE = '1' AND m.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' AND su.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' UNION ALL (SELECT m.TO_USER_ID AS user_id, m.CONTENT, m.TYPE, m.CREATE_TIME, m.IS_RECALL, m.FROM_USER_ID, m.TO_USER_ID, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m2.IS_READ = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unread_count, '2' AS chat_type FROM im_message m JOIN (SELECT im.TO_USER_ID, MAX(im.CREATE_TIME) AS latest_time FROM im_message im JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT group_id,DELETE_FLAG FROM im_group_member WHERE user_id = #{userId}) gm ON im.TO_USER_ID = gm.group_id WHERE im.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and gm.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' GROUP BY im.TO_USER_ID) lgm ON m.TO_USER_ID = lgm.TO_USER_ID AND m.CREATE_TIME = lgm.latest_time LEFT JOIN im_message m2 ON m.TO_USER_ID = m2.TO_USER_ID AND m2.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' AND m2.IS_READ = 2 WHERE m.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' GROUP BY m.TO_USER_ID, m.CONTENT, m.TYPE, m.CREATE_TIME, m.IS_RECALL, m.FROM_USER_ID, m.TO_USER_ID ORDER BY m.CREATE_TIME DESC)) AS combined_results ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
